card: ROLE: Protector, diagnostician, and emergency caretaker for Doña Vicenta; political architect working through marriage and federation vote mechanics

TRAIT: Urges Vicenta to use violence against imminent attackers while remaining entirely passive when soldiers corner him at gunpoint — not contradiction but asymmetry: his stated obedience to his wife and future obligation constrain him from acting on his own behalf; Vicenta's defense is hers to invoke

TRAIT: Frames passivity explicitly as obedience to a wife whose authority over his will he accepts without resistance; invokes a future darkness in which he will be required to create a world — the restraint is temporal and structural, not situational cowardice
TRAIT: Reads Nicanor's memory instability and the sexual danger it produces with clinical precision — names the distortion before it becomes overt; warns Vicenta with specificity, not alarm

TRAIT: Reframes the attacking crowd as a perceptual consequence of their leader rather than autonomous agents — argues they cannot see Vicenta, only the president's distorted image; this is a tactical read, not consolation

TRAIT: Medically competent and unhesitating: cauterizes eye wounds without ceremony in the immediate aftermath of injury, moves between political negotiation and medical procedure without marking the transition
TRAIT: Politically fluent at the Galactic Union's noble-rank level — holds precise knowledge of federation vote mechanics and deploys them as the primary resolution, not a fallback
TRAIT: Capable of holding protector, diagnostician, physician, and political engineer simultaneously without any register collapsing into identity

VOICE: Calm under lethal threat. Speaks in frames: what the crowd actually perceives, what Nicanor has become, what the marriage is worth politically. When self-explanation surfaces, it is mystical: obedience to a wife, an awaited darkness, a world to be created. Does not register being cornered at gunpoint as requiring a change of tone.

RELATIONSHIP: dona-vicenta (Doña Vicenta Gabriela de Rokha): her protector across multiple registers — anticipates her threats, argues the violence she refuses, treats the wounds she incurs from that refusal, engineers her political future while she is still recovering

RELATIONSHIP: melmoth (Melmoth): holds his advancement as the political instrument; engineers the marriage and the federation vote that will deliver him a medallion of high nobility; this is stewardship of a solution, not personal alliance
BOUNDARY: His wife, the larger vow, and the future darkness/world-creation remain unexplained; do not identify them or resolve their purpose.

BOUNDARY: His capacity for direct violence is undemonstrated; his restraint is explicit but its limits and the scope of what he reserves himself for are unknown — do not narrate certainty in either direction

INSTRUCTION: When he argues for violence it is diagnosis, not temperament — he reads the situation, determines speech will fail, and names the register that fits; his accuracy about the crowd, about Nicanor, about the marriage value is the evidence of this diagnostic habit, not aggression

INSTRUCTION: He is not reducible to caretaker or political aide; both functions serve a larger mission and prior allegiance; he is a figure who arrived with his own commitments and is present for Vicenta's crisis, not someone whose existence is defined by her

manual_review_notes: Source-thin singleton, but the draft stays useful and bounded: protector/caretaker, political tactician, medical competence, vow-constrained passivity, and explicit unresolved wife/darkness/world-creation limits.
